_comment: Each theme traces specific Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek words, never hand-picked verses, so every highlighted verse can be checked against the original text. `strong` is a Strong's number; every STEPBible sub-entry of it whose lexicon gloss contains one of `match` is included. Glosses that start with a capital letter belong to names and places and are skipped, unless `capitalized` is true (for roots whose own gloss is capitalized, such as Passover or Christ). `exclude` lists sub-entries to leave out although their gloss matches (seed: semen). `atlas build` fails if any entry matches nothing, or if an exclude names a sub-entry the entry would not include, so a typo cannot silently empty a theme. Shared links name themes by `id`, so ids never change.

themes.name: Lamb
themes.blurb: From Abel's flock and the Passover to the Lamb on the throne.

themes.name: Light
themes.blurb: The first words of creation, the lamp of the law, the light of the world.

themes.name: Shepherd
themes.blurb: Shepherding as the picture of leading, feeding and protecting a people.

themes.name: Vine and vineyard
themes.blurb: Israel as a planted vine, the vineyard song, the true vine.

themes.name: Bread
themes.blurb: Daily bread, manna, the bread of the presence, the bread of life.

themes.name: Water
themes.blurb: The deep at creation, water from the rock, living water.

themes.name: Rock
themes.blurb: God as a rock and refuge, the rock in the wilderness, the house on the rock.

themes.name: Fire
themes.blurb: The burning bush, the pillar of fire, refining fire, tongues of fire.

themes.name: Blood
themes.blurb: Life is in the blood: sacrifice, covenant and the cup.

themes.name: Covenant
themes.blurb: Noah, Abraham, Sinai, David, and the new covenant.

themes.name: Seed and offspring
themes.blurb: The promised offspring, from Genesis 3 to Galatians 3.

themes.name: Bride and bridegroom
themes.blurb: Marriage as the picture of God and his people. The Hebrew word for bridegroom, חָתָן, also means son-in-law.

themes.name: Temple and tabernacle
themes.blurb: Where God dwells with people: tent, temple, body, city.

themes.name: Tree
themes.blurb: The tree of life, the cursed tree, the leaves for healing.

themes.name: The way
themes.blurb: Walking in the way, the two ways, the way prepared in the wilderness.

themes.name: Spirit, wind and breath
themes.blurb: One word in Hebrew and one in Greek carry all three meanings.

themes.name: Passover
themes.blurb: From the night of the LORD’s Passover in Egypt to Christ, our Passover lamb.

themes.name: Redeemer
themes.blurb: From the kinsman-redeemer of Ruth to a ransom for many.

themes.name: Atonement and the mercy seat
themes.blurb: From the mercy seat to the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

themes.name: The Anointed One
themes.blurb: Anointed priests and kings, and the Messiah, which is translated as Christ.

themes.name: Sabbath rest
themes.blurb: The seventh day of rest, and a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

themes.name: The kingdom
themes.blurb: The kingdoms of the earth, and a kingdom that will never be destroyed.

themes.name: Firstborn
themes.blurb: Israel, the LORD’s firstborn son, and the firstborn over all creation.
